label: A2B_hP9_152_c_a-001
title: $\alpha$ (low) Quartz (SiO$_{2}$) Structure
comments:
When $x_{1}=1/2$, $y_{2}=2x_{2}$, and $z_{2}=1/2$ this transforms into the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_hP9_180_i_d-001}{high $\beta$-quartz ($C8$)} structure, with the phase transformation occuring at 573$^{\circ}$C (Wright, 1981). 
 This structure can also be found in the enantiomorphic space group $P3_{2}21$ \#154. 
 More information about SiO$_{2}$ structures can be found in our article on \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$}.
